title: Sequencers and connectors
en:
Sequencers show order: First, … Then / After that, … Finally, …

Connectors join ideas: and (add), but / although (contrast), because (reason), so (result).

The system was slow, so we used paper forms. We used paper forms because the system was slow. Although it was late, we finished the report.

Time: when, as soon as, after + clause / -ing, later, in the end (= finally, after a long time).
ru: Последовательность: first, then, after that, finally / in the end. Связки: because — потому что (причина), so — поэтому (результат), but / although — но / хотя, as soon as — как только.

boss.situation: Describe how a document goes through approval in your department. Use first, then, after that, finally and because / so / although.
samples: First, the specialist prepares the document.
Then the head of department checks it.
After that, we send it to the legal team because they must approve it.
Although the process is slow, it reduces mistakes.
Finally, the director signs it, so the document becomes official.

qs.q: The office was closed, ___ we went home.
We were late ___ there was a lot of traffic.
___ it was raining, we walked to the plant.
___, open the file. Then click “Save”.
We waited for two hours, and ___ the bus arrived.
qs.exp: After a long time → in the end.
qs.ru: В конце концов — in the end.

qs.q: Call me ___ you arrive.
I like my job, ___ the salary is low.
___ that, we had lunch in the canteen.
“Although” and “but” both show contrast.
qs.exp: Both show contrast; although starts a clause.

qs.q: “So” gives a reason, “because” gives a result.
I was tired, ___ I went to bed early.
a: so

qs.q: She got the job ___ she speaks good English.
a: because

qs.q: ___ the meeting was long, it was useful.
a: Although

qs.q: First we checked the data. ___ that, we wrote the report.
a: After

qs.q: We tried three times and ___ we found the error.
a: finally
in the end
eventually
qs.exp: At last → finally / in the end.

qs.q: I'll send you the file ___ soon as I finish it.
a: as

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the system was slow so we used paper forms

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: we stayed late because the deadline was tomorrow

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: although it was expensive we bought it

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: call me as soon as you get the results
qs.exp: as soon as + present for future.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: after that we sent it to the director

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I was ill, because I stayed at home.”
a: I was ill, so I stayed at home.
I stayed at home because I was ill.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “Although it was cold, but we went out.”
a: Although it was cold, we went out.
It was cold, but we went out.
qs.exp: Don't use although and but together.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “At the end we found the problem.”
a: In the end we found the problem.
In the end, we found the problem.
Finally we found the problem.
Finally, we found the problem.
qs.exp: After a long time → in the end (at the end = at the final point of something).
qs.ru: В конце концов — in the end.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “After that we arrived, we had dinner.”
a: After we arrived, we had dinner.
After arriving, we had dinner.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “I'll call you as soon as I will arrive.”
a: I'll call you as soon as I arrive.
I will call you as soon as I arrive.
qs.exp: No will after as soon as.
qs.ru: После as soon as — без will.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She was late so the bus didn't come.”
a: She was late because the bus didn't come.
She was late because the bus did not come.
The bus didn't come, so she was late.

qs.q: Система не работала, поэтому мы ушли домой.
a: The system didn't work, so we went home.
The system did not work, so we went home.
The system was not working, so we went home.
The system wasn't working, so we went home.

qs.q: Я опоздал, потому что была пробка.
a: I was late because there was a traffic jam.
I was late because there was traffic.
I was late because of a traffic jam.
I was late because of the traffic.
I was late because there was a lot of traffic.

qs.q: Хотя было поздно, мы закончили отчёт.
a: Although it was late, we finished the report.
Although it was late we finished the report.

qs.q: Сначала мы проверяем документы.
a: First we check the documents.
First, we check the documents.
First we check documents.

qs.q: После этого мы отправили отчёт директору.
a: After that we sent the report to the director.
After that, we sent the report to the director.
After that we sent the director the report.

qs.q: Позвони мне, как только получишь результаты.
a: Call me as soon as you get the results.
Call me as soon as you receive the results.
Phone me as soon as you get the results.

qs.q: В конце концов мы нашли ошибку.
a: In the end we found the mistake.
In the end, we found the mistake.
In the end we found the error.
In the end, we found the error.
Finally we found the mistake.
Finally, we found the mistake.
Finally we found the error.
Finally, we found the error.
qs.ru: В конце концов — in the end.

qs.q: Мне нравится моя работа, но она трудная.
a: I like my job, but it is difficult.
I like my job but it is difficult.
I like my job, but it is hard.
I like my work, but it is difficult.
I like my work, but it is hard.
